source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including all written/read and other notes, not normalized reconstructions.
source.public_versification_note: Public Joshua 1–8 and Hebrew source references align one to one. All 186 original source records are bound exactly once.

key_decisions.decision: Keeps lethal Jericho comparison and explicitly distinguishes permitted plunder from the former prohibition.
Preserves thirty thousand without harmonizing it to the five thousand later in the account.
Retains the approximate five thousand as a separate textual notice without inventing its relation to the thirty thousand.
Preserves the deployment summary and night notice in place; rear detachment renders the difficult heel/rear term with a note.
Renders moed as appointed place, notes time alternative, and retains the king’s lack of knowledge.
Makes the converging forces intelligible and keeps the totalizing survivor/fugitive claim.
Retains the exhaustive killing outside and inside the city rather than reducing it to a battle victory.
Keeps the exact twelve thousand and explicitly includes women in the stated total.
Preserves the sustained gesture, Joshua’s agency, and herem’s full human scope.
Preserves tree, corpse, sunset removal, and memorial heap without specifying an unmentioned execution technique.
Clarifies the repeated writing clause as Joshua’s public inscription without speculating on the copy’s length.
